title: Length of the leading-one split
statement: For every finite Boolean string $x$, let $(k,y)$ be the pair obtained by removing its longest initial run of $1$s, so that $k$ is the run length and $y$ is the remaining string. Then $k+|y|=|x|$.
replaced:
For every bit string $x$, if $k$ is the length of the longest prefix of $x$ consisting only
of $1$s and $y$ is the remainder of $x$ after that prefix, then $k + |y| = |x|$.
